title: Highland Cow Calendar 3D, 24 Figures – A New Cow Every Day
seo_title: Highland Cow Calendar 3D, 24 Figures – Advent Calendar
seo_description: Advent calendar with 24 plastic Highland cow figures, one behind every door. Pre-filled and ready – open the box and start on December 1.
descriptionHtml:
The chocolate calendar is gone before breakfast

The door is opened on the fly, the piece of chocolate is eaten in ten seconds, and the rest of the day has nothing left to look forward to. Anyone who is hooked on Highland cows wants something to hold every morning – not a piece of chocolate that disappears right away.

Filled with 24 figures, a new one every day

The calendar arrives pre-filled: 24 doors, a small plastic Highland cow figure behind each one, packed in blister packs. The box is printed with "Highland Cow Advent Calendar 2026" and "24 happy Highland cows". Nothing to buy or wrap yourself – open the box and December 1 is ready.

Features

  • 24 figures, one per door – a new Highland cow to hold every morning until Christmas Eve.
  • Blister-packed plastic figures – each figure sits protected and intact until the door is opened.
  • The box is printed for the purpose – "Highland Cow Advent Calendar 2026" is on the lid, no plain cardboard box.
  • Nothing to buy or wrap yourself – the calendar is ready straight out of the package.

We can't confirm whether all 24 figures are different or whether some repeat – it isn't stated in the product information.

Our guarantee

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
